privacy.title: Privacy & Reading Analytics
privacy.desc: How this site counts reads — and what it never stores.
privacy.intro: This site uses self-hosted, aggregate-only analytics to answer how many people read and where they come from. No third-party analytics, no advertising or tracking cookies, and no cross-day or cross-device visitor profiles.
privacy.cookie_body: When you open an article, the server sets an HttpOnly cookie named view_<article ID> for up to 24 hours. It exists only to avoid counting the same browser twice; it never identifies you, is not shared across sites, and cannot be switched off without breaking the counter.
privacy.purpose_body: Apart from the IP, the fields below come from request headers and are used only for daily aggregates; raw values are not stored:
privacy.item_cookie: view_ cookie: one read per browser within 24 hours.
privacy.item_hmac: IP address: used only as an input to HMAC-SHA256 for a 24-hour dedupe token. The IP itself is never stored or shown in the dashboard.
privacy.item_ua: User-Agent: classify device (desktop / mobile / tablet / unknown) and filter bots and prefetches.
privacy.item_referer: Referer: domain only (path and query stripped), to distinguish internal clicks from external referrals.
privacy.item_country: Two-letter country code: supplied by the edge network for regional distribution; no province-level or precise location.
privacy.item_device: Device class: a four-value enum from client hints or UA; no model or fingerprint.
privacy.retention_body: Dedupe tokens are deleted after 24 hours by a daily cleanup; daily aggregates and dimension buckets are kept for 400 days. The day boundary follows the site time zone Asia/Shanghai; everything is stored as (article, day, bucket) counters — never as individual visit records.
privacy.scope_title: What we explicitly do not do
privacy.scope_body: No cross-day or cross-device visitor IDs; no canvas / WebGL / font fingerprinting; no per-visitor views or exports; no raw IP, full UA, or precise coordinates in the database. This batch adds no consent banner because it uses only an essential cookie and aggregate data.
privacy.contact_body: Questions about these metrics or retention? Open an issue in the Mintinkd/Blog_Website repository.
privacy.note: This page applies to Reading Analytics Tier 0. If finer-grained metrics are added later, this page will be updated first.
